newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open off 0.20 to 0.30 cent.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open off 0.20 to 0.30 cent.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were expected to open 0.20 to 0.30 cent weaker Tuesday as the market continued to shrug off the continuing strike at Neves Corvo copper mine in Portugal.
LME copper stocks rose 2,250 tonnes Tuesday to 133,350 tonnes, the continued rise alleviating any immediate fears regarding the Portuguese strike, dealers said.
September COMEX last traded at 109.20 cents a lb on ACCESS, off 0.35 cent from Monday's close.
